Portfolio news brief — 5 September 2026

Market and major-name developments
- The 'Fast Money' traders react to President's trade threat aimed at the Federal Reserve. (CNBC)
- Rick Bensignor, Bensignor Investment Strategies founder and managing partner, joins 'Closing Bell Overtime' to talk the technical trade around markets, bond yields, and commodities. (CNBC)
- I get cautious when an artificial intelligence (AI) stock asks investors to pay today for profits that may not show up for years. Nvidia ( NVDA +0.84% ) has been the dominant player in AI hardware for some time, but its stock still deserves a closer look even after gaining more than 360% over the past three years (as of Sept. (The Motley Fool)
- Accounting is complicated, which is why quarterly and annual reports are so long and boring to read. But when you see a company like Alphabet ( GOOG -1.05% ) reporting that its second-quarter earnings benefited from $77.1 billion in unrealized gains, you have to pause for a second. (The Motley Fool)

Bitcoin (BTC)
- Three big falls, three very different businesses. FREE Report: One Stock for Virtually Every Portfolio Bitcoin ( CRYPTO: BTC ) is back below US$77,000. (The Motley Fool Australia)
- On the basis of its price right now relative to where it was at the same point in its prior four-year market cycles, Bitcoin ( BTC +0.35% ) looks pretty cheap, with a price of $77,155 as of Sept. 1, 38% below its last all-time high near $126,080, which was set in October 2025. (The Motley Fool)

Apple (AAPL; VOO top-five holding)
- Apple seemingly changes CEOs about as much as the Pittsburgh Steelers change head coaches, but both are embarking on a new era this month. John Ternus became CEO of Apple ( AAPL -2.51% ) on Sept. (The Motley Fool)
- If you're looking to invest in dividend-paying stocks for that sweet passive income, good for you! Dividends are a great way to collect cash without having to sell any stocks -- and that cash can help support you or can be deployed to buy more shares of stock. (The Motley Fool)

Alphabet (GOOGL; VOO top-five holding)
- Whatever Google has done to improve its artificial intelligence assistant app, called Gemini, over the past year has clearly been worth it. From 400 million monthly users in May 2025 to 1 billion monthly users as of last month, the app has become the fastest-growing product in Alphabet 's ( GOOG -1.05% ) ( GOOGL -1.11% ) history. (The Motley Fool)

Routine price moves and stock-picking speculation are intentionally excluded.
